RR2.text: A university user shall search published course offerings and inspect their course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remainingâseat information.

RR3.text: A student shall register for a selected course offering during its registration period and receive the result.

RR5.text: Before accepting a registration or a swap, the system shall perform enrollmentâeligibility validation, including registrationâperiod, duplicateâenrollment, capacity, and timetableâconflict checks.

RR7.text: A student shall drop a selected registration during the allowed period and receive the result.

RR8.text: While viewing the current class schedule, a student may optionally export it in a downloadable format using the information already presented by that view; the schedule view remains complete without an export.

use_case_specs.name: Search published course offerings
use_case_specs.trigger: University User requests a search for published course offerings.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: No published course offerings match the search criteria

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the user that no matching offerings were found.

main_scenario.sentence: University User provides search criteria for published course offerings.
System processes the criteria and retrieves matching published course offerings.
System presents the matching offerings with course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remaining-seat information.
University User selects an offering to view its details.
System displays the detailed information for the selected offering.

finding_keys_before: semantic:spec.causal-flow-consistency:[semantic] move the extension to branch after step 2 where the match result is known.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If no published course offerings match the criteria, the system informs the user that no results were found.

success_guarantee.sentence: The system delivers the requested course offering information, including course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remaining-seat details.

use_case_specs.name: Register for selected course offering
use_case_specs.trigger: Student selects a course offering and requests registration.

handling_steps.sentence: System returns a failure result to the student.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests registration for the selected course offering.
System validates enrollment eligibility, including registration-period, duplicate-enrollment, capacity, and timetable-conflict checks.
System records the student's registration for the offering.
System returns a success result to the student.

finding_keys_after: semantic:spec.no-hidden-branching:[semantic] add an extension that handles validation failure and returns an error result.
finding_keys_before: semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the step that informs the student of the validation failure reason.
semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the step that informs the student of the validation failure reason.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: When registration is not accepted, the system makes no changes to enrollment data.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's registration is recorded and the offering's available capacity is reduced, preserving enrollment uniqueness.

use_case_specs.name: Swap current registration for another offering
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to swap a current registration for another course offering.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of the validation failure and the reason.
System aborts the swap and informs the student that capacity could not be reserved.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to swap a current registration for another offering.
System validates enrollment eligibility including registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflict.
System atomically swaps the current registration for the new offering.
System returns the swap result to the student.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If eligibility validation fails, the system reports the failure and no registration changes occur.
If a concurrent operation prevents preserving capacity, the system reports the failure and no registration changes occur.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's registration is updated to the new offering and the previous registration is removed, preserving enrollment capacity, uniqueness, and waitlist ordering.
The system reports a successful swap result to the student.

use_case_specs.name: View current registrations and class schedule
use_case_specs.trigger: Student requests to view current registrations and class schedule.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view current registrations and class schedule.
System retrieves the student's current registration records.
System compiles the class schedule based on the retrieved registrations.
System presents the registration list and schedule to the student.

preconditions: Student is authenticated to the system.

success_guarantee.sentence: Student sees an up-to-date list of their registered courses and the corresponding class schedule.

use_case_specs.name: Export class schedule
use_case_specs.trigger: The student requests to export the schedule.

main_scenario.sentence: Student initiates export of the schedule.
System generates a downloadable file containing the schedule data.
System provides the file to the student for download.

preconditions: The student is viewing the current class schedule.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: The schedule view remains unchanged.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student receives a downloadable file that accurately reflects the schedule currently displayed.
The schedule view remains complete and unchanged.

use_case_specs.name: Drop selected registration
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to drop a selected registration.

main_scenario.sentence: Student indicates the registration to be dropped.
System removes the indicated registration from the student's enrollment.
System updates enrollment capacity for the course offering.
System returns a confirmation that the registration was dropped.

preconditions: The drop period for the selected course offering is currently open.
The student is currently enrolled in the selected registration.

attempts.detail: Static validation cleared and semantic validation became reachable.

semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the extension that handles a missing registration or tie it to an explicit requirement.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the drop operation fails, the student's schedule remains unchanged.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's schedule no longer includes the dropped registration.

use_case_specs.trigger: System rejects the student's registration because the offering is full and its waitlist is enabled

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to join the waitlist for the offering that was rejected because it is full
System records the student on the offering's waitlist preserving the waitlist order
System confirms the waitlist entry to the student

finding_keys_before: semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the duplicateâwaitlist extension or tie it to an explicit requirement.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the waitlist join fails, the original registration remains rejected and no waitlist entry is added

success_guarantee.sentence: The student is placed on the offering's waitlist in correct order while the original registration remains rejected

use_case_specs.name: View and cancel own waitlist entries
use_case_specs.trigger: Student selects the option to view their waitlist entries.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that there are no waitlist entries.

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: Selected waitlist entry is no longer present

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the entry cannot be cancelled because it is no longer on the waitlist.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view their waitlist entries.
System displays the student's current waitlist entries.
Student selects a waitlist entry to cancel.
System removes the selected entry from the waitlist.
System confirms the cancellation to the student.

preconditions: Student is authenticated to the system.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the cancellation cannot be performed because the entry is absent, the waitlist remains unchanged.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's waitlist no longer contains the cancelled entry.
Enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering remain correct after the cancellation as required by RR16.

use_case_specs.name: Review assigned courses and rosters
use_case_specs.trigger: Professor requests to review assigned course offerings and their student rosters.

main_scenario.sentence: Professor requests the review of assigned courses and rosters.
System presents the list of course offerings assigned to the professor.
Professor identifies a course offering from the presented list.
System presents the current student roster for the identified course offering.

preconditions: Professor has at least one course offering assigned.

success_guarantee.sentence: The professor receives the list of assigned course offerings and, for any selected offering, receives the up-to-date roster of enrolled students.

use_case_specs.name: Create and update academic terms and registration periods
use_case_specs.trigger: Academic Administrator initiates a request to create or update an academic term.

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator indicates a request to create a new academic term or to modify an existing academic term.
Academic Administrator provides the term identifier, name, start date, end date, and the registration period opening and closing dates.
System stores the term information together with its registration period data.
System notifies the Academic Administrator that the term and registration period have been successfully created or updated.

preconditions: Academic Administrator is authenticated and has permission to manage academic terms.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the operation cannot be completed, the system leaves existing term and registration period data unchanged.

success_guarantee.sentence: The academic term and its registration periods are persisted and become available for course scheduling and student enrollment.

use_case_specs.name: Manage course offerings
use_case_specs.trigger: Academic Administrator requests to manage a course offering

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: the information supplied by the Academic Administrator is incomplete or inconsistent

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Academic Administrator of the validation errors

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator provides the course offering identifier, instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and selects the desired action (create, update, publish, or cancel)
System validates that the supplied information is complete and consistent
System records the course offering with the specified instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and updates its status according to the selected action
System confirms the successful completion of the operation to the Academic Administrator

minimal_guarantee.sentence: When validation fails, no course offering is created, updated, published, or canceled

success_guarantee.sentence: The course offering is stored with the instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and status reflecting the requested action

use_case_specs.name: Search published course offerings
use_case_specs.trigger: University User requests a search for published course offerings.

main_scenario.sentence: University User provides search criteria for published course offerings.
System processes the criteria and retrieves matching published course offerings.
System presents the matching offerings with course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remaining-seat information.
University User selects an offering to view its details.
System displays the detailed information for the selected offering.

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: No published course offerings match the search criteria

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the user that no matching offerings were found.

success_guarantee.sentence: The system delivers the requested course offering information, including course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remaining-seat details.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If no published course offerings match the criteria, the system informs the user that no results were found.

use_case_specs.name: Register for selected course offering
use_case_specs.trigger: Student selects a course offering and requests registration.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests registration for the selected course offering.
System validates enrollment eligibility, including registration-period, duplicate-enrollment, capacity, and timetable-conflict checks.
System records the student's registration for the offering.
System returns a success result to the student.

handling_steps.sentence: System returns a failure result to the student.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's registration is recorded and the offering's available capacity is reduced, preserving enrollment uniqueness.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: When registration is not accepted, the system makes no changes to enrollment data.

finding_keys_before: semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the step that informs the student of the validation failure reason.

use_case_specs.name: Swap current registration for another offering
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to swap a current registration for another course offering.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to swap a current registration for another offering.
System validates enrollment eligibility including registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflict.
System atomically swaps the current registration for the new offering.
System returns the swap result to the student.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of the validation failure and the reason.
System aborts the swap and informs the student that capacity could not be reserved.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's registration is updated to the new offering and the previous registration is removed, preserving enrollment capacity, uniqueness, and waitlist ordering.
The system reports a successful swap result to the student.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If eligibility validation fails, the system reports the failure and no registration changes occur.
If a concurrent operation prevents preserving capacity, the system reports the failure and no registration changes occur.

use_case_specs.name: View current registrations and class schedule
preconditions: Student is authenticated to the system.
use_case_specs.trigger: Student requests to view current registrations and class schedule.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view current registrations and class schedule.
System retrieves the student's current registration records.
System compiles the class schedule based on the retrieved registrations.
System presents the registration list and schedule to the student.

success_guarantee.sentence: Student sees an up-to-date list of their registered courses and the corresponding class schedule.

use_case_specs.name: Export class schedule
preconditions: The student is viewing the current class schedule.
use_case_specs.trigger: The student requests to export the schedule.

main_scenario.sentence: Student initiates export of the schedule.
System generates a downloadable file containing the schedule data.
System provides the file to the student for download.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student receives a downloadable file that accurately reflects the schedule currently displayed.
The schedule view remains complete and unchanged.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: The schedule view remains unchanged.

use_case_specs.name: Drop selected registration
preconditions: The drop period for the selected course offering is currently open.
The student is currently enrolled in the selected registration.
use_case_specs.trigger: Student initiates a request to drop a selected registration.

main_scenario.sentence: Student indicates the registration to be dropped.
System removes the indicated registration from the student's enrollment.
System updates enrollment capacity for the course offering.
System returns a confirmation that the registration was dropped.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's schedule no longer includes the dropped registration.
Enrollment capacity for the course reflects the freed seat.
Registration uniqueness is maintained for all students.
Waitlist ordering is preserved, and the first eligible waitlisted student is enrolled if capacity allows.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the drop operation fails, the student's schedule remains unchanged.

attempts.detail: Static validation cleared and semantic validation became reachable.

use_case_specs.trigger: System rejects the student's registration because the offering is full and its waitlist is enabled

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to join the waitlist for the offering that was rejected because it is full
System records the student on the offering's waitlist preserving the waitlist order
System confirms the waitlist entry to the student

success_guarantee.sentence: The student is placed on the offering's waitlist in correct order while the original registration remains rejected
Enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering are preserved despite concurrent operations

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the waitlist join fails, the original registration remains rejected and no waitlist entry is added

finding_keys_before: semantic:spec.no-scope-creep:[semantic] remove the duplicateâwaitlist extension or tie it to an explicit requirement.

use_case_specs.name: View and cancel own waitlist entries
preconditions: Student is authenticated to the system.
use_case_specs.trigger: Student selects the option to view their waitlist entries.

main_scenario.sentence: Student requests to view their waitlist entries.
System displays the student's current waitlist entries.
Student selects a waitlist entry to cancel.
System removes the selected entry from the waitlist.
System confirms the cancellation to the student.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that there are no waitlist entries.

extensions.label: 4a
extensions.condition: Selected waitlist entry is no longer present

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student that the entry cannot be cancelled because it is no longer on the waitlist.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's waitlist no longer contains the cancelled entry.
Enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering remain correct after the cancellation as required by RR16.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the cancellation cannot be performed because the entry is absent, the waitlist remains unchanged.

use_case_specs.name: Review assigned courses and rosters
preconditions: Professor has at least one course offering assigned.
use_case_specs.trigger: Professor requests to review assigned course offerings and their student rosters.

main_scenario.sentence: Professor requests the review of assigned courses and rosters.
System presents the list of course offerings assigned to the professor.
Professor identifies a course offering from the presented list.
System presents the current student roster for the identified course offering.

success_guarantee.sentence: The professor receives the list of assigned course offerings and, for any selected offering, receives the up-to-date roster of enrolled students.

use_case_specs.name: Create and update academic terms and registration periods
preconditions: Academic Administrator is authenticated and has permission to manage academic terms.
use_case_specs.trigger: Academic Administrator initiates a request to create or update an academic term.

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator indicates a request to create a new academic term or to modify an existing academic term.
Academic Administrator provides the term identifier, name, start date, end date, and the registration period opening and closing dates.
System stores the term information together with its registration period data.
System notifies the Academic Administrator that the term and registration period have been successfully created or updated.

success_guarantee.sentence: The academic term and its registration periods are persisted and become available for course scheduling and student enrollment.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the operation cannot be completed, the system leaves existing term and registration period data unchanged.

use_case_specs.trigger: Academic Administrator requests to manage a course offering

main_scenario.sentence: Academic Administrator provides the course offering identifier, instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and selects the desired action (create, update, publish, or cancel)
System validates that the supplied information is complete and consistent
System records the course offering with the specified instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and updates its status according to the selected action
System confirms the successful completion of the operation to the Academic Administrator

extensions.label: 2a
extensions.condition: the information supplied by the Academic Administrator is incomplete or inconsistent

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the Academic Administrator of the validation errors

success_guarantee.sentence: The course offering is stored with the instructor, meeting schedule, enrollment capacity, and status reflecting the requested action
The Academic Administrator receives confirmation that the operation succeeded

minimal_guarantee.sentence: When validation fails, no course offering is created, updated, published, or canceled

use_case_specs.name: Swap current registration for another offering

System validates enrollment eligibility including registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflict.
System atomically swaps the current registration for the new offering.
System returns the swap result to the student.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of the validation failure and the reason.

The schedule view remains complete and unchanged.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: The schedule view remains unchanged.

refined_requirements.text: Students, professors, and academic administrators are specialized roles of a university user.

A student shall view current registrations and the resulting class schedule.

use_case_specs.name: Swap current registration for another offering

System validates enrollment eligibility including registration period, duplicate enrollment, capacity, and timetable conflict.
System atomically swaps the current registration for the new offering.
System returns the swap result to the student.

handling_steps.sentence: System informs the student of the validation failure and the reason.
System aborts the swap and informs the student that capacity could not be reserved.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student's registration is updated to the new offering and the previous registration is removed, preserving enrollment capacity, uniqueness, and waitlist ordering.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If eligibility validation fails, the system reports the failure and no registration changes occur.

System retrieves the student's current registration records.

success_guarantee.sentence: Student sees an up-to-date list of their registered courses and the corresponding class schedule.

success_guarantee.sentence: The student receives a downloadable file that accurately reflects the schedule currently displayed.
The schedule view remains complete and unchanged.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: The schedule view remains unchanged.

minimal_guarantee.sentence: If the drop operation fails, the student's schedule remains unchanged.

refined_requirements.text: Students, professors, and academic administrators are specialized roles of a university user.
A university user shall search published course offerings and inspect their course, section, instructor, meeting schedule, capacity, and remainingâseat information.
A student shall register for a selected course offering during its registration period and receive the result.
A student shall atomically swap a current registration for another course offering and receive the result.

Before accepting a registration or a swap, the system shall perform enrollmentâeligibility validation, including registrationâperiod, duplicateâenrollment, capacity, and timetableâconflict checks.
A student shall view current registrations and the resulting class schedule.
A student shall drop a selected registration during the allowed period and receive the result.

While viewing the current class schedule, a student may optionally export it in a downloadable format using the information already presented by that view; the schedule view remains complete without an export.
When registration is rejected only because an offering is full and its waitlist is enabled, the student may join the waitlist; the rejected registration remains a complete result without joining.
A student shall view and cancel their own waitlist entries.
A professor shall review assigned course offerings and their current student rosters.
An academic administrator shall create and update academic terms and their registration periods.
An academic administrator shall create, update, publish, or cancel course offerings and assign their instructor, meeting schedule, and enrollment capacity.
The system shall authorize each protected operation according to the authenticated universityâuser role.
Course, offering, term, universityâuser, registration, and waitlist information shall survive application and server restarts.
Concurrent registration, swap, drop, and waitlist operations shall preserve enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering.
The pilot shall be deployed in the AWS Seoul Region (apânortheastâ2).
The monthly cloud budget for the pilot shall not exceed 500 USD.
The pilot shall use Docker on Linux virtual machines provisioned with Terraform and temporary HTTP endpoints.
HTTPS, TLS certificates, and domain management are outside the pilot scope.
The pilot may not use a managed database service, Kubernetes, or serverless compute.
The pilot shall use synthetic data instead of real personal data.
Recovery from a dataâstorage server failure is outside the pilot scope.
